svg.text: Three loads and two stores a cycle through four pipes. Queue entries are taken at issue; a store is an address uop and a data uop.
same-page masked compare before the full add
load-to-load bypass: 3 cycles when base is a fresh L1 hit
matching load waits for its store; others predicted free
allocated at issue, released before retire
poison bit on snoop before non-spec
AMX ops wait here until non-spec
partial overlap: bytes from queue plus L1 at full rate (2 entries: +1 cycle)
zero-cycle load when store and load share the address register
no load value prediction, no address prediction on M1
MMU walk cache for upper levels, leaves from L2
piggyback: queued requests to one page share a lookup
indexed permissions, no shootdown on change
piggybacked loads to one element share an access; fills take bank cycles (about 1 in 7)
set = VA bits 13:6, inside the page offset
8 bit utag from VA 47:14 picks the way
L1 to L2 32 B/cycle each way
fill buffer per line, misses merge
load woken as the fill passes
train on virtual addresses in the LSU
access map per region, stride and density patterns
1 dereference level, needs 3 accesses to arm
stride up to 8 KiB, reaches 64 KiB past the array
pointer and line share a 4 GiB region; 128-entry filter
history of just under 256 entries, 15 KiB regions
L2 rates each core every 32 cycles, ~4 prefetches per region
Also measured: TSO mode switch for Rosetta, exclusive monitor tied to L1D residency (64 B granule), no redundant load/store elimination.
